
Qwen3.6 35B-A3B on what-if: Apple M5 (10-core GPU), 24 GB unified memory
Scenario: Claude Code — 20k-token system prompt + tools, then ~2.5k new tokens and ~300 output tokens per turn

RUNTIME                                  FILE              CONTEXT  MEMORY        FIRST REPLY  FOLLOW-UP  WRITES AT  TASK*
Ollama (defaults)                        Q4_K_M 22.1 GB    4k ⚠     ✗ 21.3/16 GB  —            —          —          —
Ollama (tuned)                           Q4_K_M 22.1 GB    56k      ✗ 22.4/16 GB  —            —          —          —
llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults)      Q4_K_M 22.1 GB    4k ⚠     ✗ 21.3/16 GB  —            —          —          —
llama.cpp (llama-server) (tuned)         Q4_K_M 22.1 GB    56k      ✗ 22.4/16 GB  —            —          —          —
LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults)  Q4_K_M 22.1 GB    4k ⚠     ✗ 21.5/16 GB  —            —          —          —
LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (tuned)     Q4_K_M 22.1 GB    56k      ✗ 22.4/16 GB  —            —          —          —
LM Studio (MLX engine) (defaults)        MLX-4bit 20.4 GB  4k ⚠     ✗ 19.7/16 GB  —            —          —          —
LM Studio (MLX engine) (tuned)           MLX-4bit 20.4 GB  56k      ✗ 20.7/16 GB  —            —          —          —
mlx-lm server (defaults)                 MLX-4bit 20.4 GB  256k     ✗ 24.6/16 GB  —            —          —          —
mlx-lm server (tuned)                    MLX-4bit 20.4 GB  56k      ✗ 20.7/16 GB  —            —          —          —

FIRST REPLY = cold start (model load + the whole prompt). FOLLOW-UP = a typical later turn (new tokens only + the reply).
* TASK = a 40-call agent task; at datacenter speed it would take about 2 min 00 s. "✗ breaks" = the harness prompt does not fit the context.
Typical error (about 3 in 4 predictions): generation ±60%, prompt processing ±70%. Apple M5: new generation, little benchmark data; hybrid linear-attention model: little benchmark data for its recurrent layers.
Tip: device spec partly assumed: a calibration probe would tighten this.

  · macOS lets the GPU use about 16 of 24 GB by default (raise with sudo sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb)
  · M5-generation matmul throughput assumed (GPU neural accelerators); little benchmark data yet

  ⚠ Ollama (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (Ollama default for 16 GiB of GPU memory): the prompt is silently truncated and the agent will misbehave
  ⚠ Ollama (defaults): does not fit: needs 21.3 GB, 16.0 GB available
  ⚠ quality caveat: the trial uses the cloud's provider-dependent weights; local Q4_K_M is typically 0–3 points worse on coding tasks and makes more tool-call mistakes
  ⚠ Ollama (tuned): does not fit: needs 22.4 GB, 16.0 GB available
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (model native context, reduced to fit free memory): requests will be rejected with a context error
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (defaults): does not fit: needs 21.3 GB, 16.0 GB available
  ⚠ llama.cpp (llama-server) (tuned): does not fit: needs 22.4 GB, 16.0 GB available
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) default load setting): the middle of the conversation is silently cut
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (defaults): does not fit: needs 21.5 GB, 16.0 GB available
  ⚠ LM Studio (llama.cpp engine) (tuned): does not fit: needs 22.4 GB, 16.0 GB available
  ⚠ LM Studio (MLX engine) (defaults): Claude Code's ~20k-token prompt does not fit the 4096-token context (LM Studio (MLX engine) default load setting): the middle of the conversation is silently cut
  ⚠ LM Studio (MLX engine) (defaults): does not fit: needs 19.7 GB, 16.0 GB available
  ⚠ quality caveat: the trial uses the cloud's provider-dependent weights; local MLX-4bit is typically 0–3 points worse on coding tasks and makes more tool-call mistakes
  ⚠ LM Studio (MLX engine) (tuned): does not fit: needs 20.7 GB, 16.0 GB available
  ⚠ mlx-lm server (defaults): does not fit: needs 24.6 GB, 16.0 GB available
  ⚠ mlx-lm server (tuned): does not fit: needs 20.7 GB, 16.0 GB available

Recommendation: no runtime gives a working Claude Code setup for this model here — try a smaller quant (--quant), a smaller model, or --ctx.
